summary.en: Public developer changelog for model launches, capability changes, pricing, and breaking API notes.
summary.zh: 面向开发者的公开变更流：模型上新、能力扩展、定价与 breaking change。

body.en:
OmniMux now publishes an **API Updates** feed so you can track what changed on the gateway without digging through release chats.

## What this log covers

- **Model launches** — new callable model ids on live pricing
- **Capability changes** — new modes, durations, resolutions, parameters
- **Pricing** — material rate or settlement changes
- **Breaking** — incompatible request/response or path changes
- **Platform** — auth, domains, public HTTP surfaces (for example Social Ops publishing)

## How to use OmniMux today

| Surface | URL |
| --- | --- |
| Console | `https://omnimux.ai` |
| OpenAI-compatible API | `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1` |
| Docs | `https://docs.omnimux.ai` |
| Status | `https://status.omnimux.ai` |

Auth for relay: Bearer `sk-…` from the console. Quota display: raw_quota ÷ 500000 = USD; **1 USD = 10 credits (积分)**.

## Baseline note

Entries dated **2026-08-09** with type `baseline` describe the **live catalog snapshot** when this feed started. They are not fabricated per-day launch history. Later entries are append-only real changes.
body.zh:
OmniMux 现提供 **API 更新日志**，便于跟踪网关侧模型与协议变更，而无需翻聊天记录。

## 本日志覆盖范围

- **模型上新** — live pricing 上可调用的新 model id
- **能力扩展** — 新模式、时长、分辨率、参数
- **定价** — 实质费率或结算规则变化
- **Breaking** — 不兼容的请求/响应或路径变更
- **平台** — 鉴权、域名、公开 HTTP 面（如社媒发布）

## 当前使用入口

| 面 | URL |
| --- | --- |
| 控制台 | `https://omnimux.ai` |
| OpenAI 兼容 API | `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1` |
| 文档 | `https://docs.omnimux.ai` |
| 状态页 | `https://status.omnimux.ai` |

Relay 鉴权：控制台签发的 Bearer `sk-…`。额度展示：raw_quota ÷ 500000 = USD；**1 USD = 10 积分**。

## 期初说明

日期为 **2026-08-09** 且类型为 `baseline` 的条目，是本日志启用时的 **live 目录快照**，不是伪造的逐日上线史。之后条目为只追加的真实变更。

title.zh: 语言系列模型（目录期初）

summary.en: Chat Completions language brands live on the gateway: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax.

body.en:
Language generation is exposed primarily through **OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions** at `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1`.

## Contract shape

- One **complete** docs page per brand (model is an enum on the page).
- Pin live model ids from console pricing / docs enums — do not invent ids.

## Brands in this baseline

| Brand | Example model ids |
| --- | --- |
| Claude | `claude-opus-4-7`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5`, … |
| GPT | `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, … |
| Gemini | `gemini-3.5-flash`, `gemini-3.1-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, … |
| Grok | `grok-4.5`, `grok-4.3`, `grok-build-0.1`, … |
| DeepSeek | `deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro` |
| GLM | `glm-5.1`, `glm-5.2` |
| Kimi | `kimi-k2.6`, `kimi-k2.7-code`, `kimi-k3` |
| MiniMax (text) | `minimax-m2.5`, `minimax-m2.7`, `minimax-m3` |

Full id list is in the entry `models` field and on each brand complete page.

## Documentation

Start from the **Language series** tab in the API manual.
body.zh:
语言生成主要通过 **OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions** 暴露：`https://api.omnimux.ai/v1`。

## 调用合同

- 每个品牌一页 **完整参数**（`model` 为页内枚举）。
- model id 以控制台定价 / 文档枚举为准，禁止臆造。

## 本期初覆盖品牌

| 品牌 | 示例 model id |
| --- | --- |
| Claude | `claude-opus-4-7`、`claude-sonnet-5`、`claude-haiku-4-5` 等 |
| GPT | `gpt-5.4`、`gpt-5.5`、`gpt-5.6-terra` 等 |
| Gemini | `gemini-3.5-flash`、`gemini-3.1-pro`、`gemini-2.5-flash` 等 |
| Grok | `grok-4.5`、`grok-4.3`、`grok-build-0.1` 等 |
| DeepSeek | `deepseek-v4-flash`、`deepseek-v4-pro` |
| GLM | `glm-5.1`、`glm-5.2` |
| Kimi | `kimi-k2.6`、`kimi-k2.7-code`、`kimi-k3` |
| MiniMax（文本） | `minimax-m2.5`、`minimax-m2.7`、`minimax-m3` |

完整 id 见本条目 `models` 字段与各品牌完整参数页。

## 文档

见 API 手册 **语言系列** 页签。

title.zh: 视频系列模型（目录期初）

summary.en: Async video SKUs: Omni Flash duration family, MiniMax H3 variants, Veo 3.1, Grok Imagine Video, LTX.
summary.zh: 异步视频 SKU：Omni Flash 时长族、MiniMax H3 变体、Veo 3.1、Grok Imagine Video、LTX。

body.en:
Video generation on OmniMux is primarily **async**:

- Create: `POST /v1/video/generations`
- Poll: `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`

## Models in this baseline

| Model id | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `omni_flash` | Omni Flash base |
| `omni_flash-4s` / `-6s` / `-10s` | Duration-oriented Omni Flash SKUs |
| `minimax-h3-t2v` | MiniMax H3 text-to-video |
| `minimax-h3-flf` | First/last-frame style I2V |
| `minimax-h3-fl2va` | FL2VA-oriented path |
| `minimax-h3-endframe` | End-frame reference I2V |
| `veo_3_1` | Veo 3.1 |
| `grok-imagine-video-1.5` | Grok Imagine Video |
| `ltx2.3-kj` | LTX 2.3 family SKU |

## Documentation

See **Video series** and **Task management** in the API manual. Do not confuse task poll with content download paths.
body.zh:
OmniMux 视频生成以 **异步任务** 为主：

- 创建：`POST /v1/video/generations`
- 查询：`GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`

## 本期初模型

| Model id | 角色 |
| --- | --- |
| `omni_flash` | Omni Flash 基础 |
| `omni_flash-4s` / `-6s` / `-10s` | 按时长划分的 Omni Flash SKU |
| `minimax-h3-t2v` | MiniMax H3 文生视频 |
| `minimax-h3-flf` | 首末帧类 I2V |
| `minimax-h3-fl2va` | FL2VA 路径 |
| `minimax-h3-endframe` | 尾帧参考 I2V |
| `veo_3_1` | Veo 3.1 |
| `grok-imagine-video-1.5` | Grok Imagine Video |
| `ltx2.3-kj` | LTX 2.3 系 SKU |

## 文档

见 API 手册 **视频系列** 与 **任务管理**。勿与内容下载路径混淆。

title.zh: 社交数据模型（目录期初）

summary.en: Read-only social data via Chat Completions-style models for TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube.
summary.zh: 只读社交数据：以 Chat Completions 形态提供的 TikTok、Instagram、X、YouTube 模型。

body.en:
**Social data** is **read-only** public content / profile style access. It is **not** social publishing.

## Platforms in this baseline

| Platform | Model ids (examples) |
| --- | --- |
| TikTok | `tiktok-user`, `tiktok-posts`, `tiktok-video`, `tiktok-search` |
| Instagram | `instagram-user`, `instagram-posts`, `instagram-post`, `instagram-search` |
| X | `x-user`, `x-posts`, `x-tweet`, `x-search` |
| YouTube | `youtube-user`, `youtube-posts`, `youtube-video`, `youtube-search` |

## Publishing (different surface)

Connect accounts and create posts use **`/api/social/v1/*`** with access token + `New-Api-User` — see **Publishing** in the API manual. Do not mix auth models.

## Documentation

See **Social data** groups under the API manual.
body.zh:
**社交数据**是 **只读** 的公开内容/资料类能力，**不是** 社媒发布。

## 本期初平台

| 平台 | Model id（示例） |
| --- | --- |
| TikTok | `tiktok-user`、`tiktok-posts`、`tiktok-video`、`tiktok-search` |
| Instagram | `instagram-user`、`instagram-posts`、`instagram-post`、`instagram-search` |
| X | `x-user`、`x-posts`、`x-tweet`、`x-search` |
| YouTube | `youtube-user`、`youtube-posts`、`youtube-video`、`youtube-search` |

## 社媒发布（另一套面）

连接账户与发帖走 **`/api/social/v1/*`**，鉴权为 access token + `New-Api-User`，见 API 手册 **社媒发布**。勿混用鉴权模型。

## 文档

见 API 手册 **社交数据** 分组。
